schema_note: MPC One touch profile measured by the M12 read-only capture on one unit. OBSERVED values come from the capture; DERIVED values come from mpfree-touch-analyze. Single-device evidence, not a universal specification.

orientation.note: DERIVED: the only one of 8 orientations that fit all four corners and both drags. Raw X runs top to bottom and raw Y runs right to left, as you face the MPC in its playing position. Apply as in rust/mpfree-touch/src/pointer.rs: swap first, then the flips.

corner_margin.note: DERIVED: how far the owner's corner touches landed from each edge, as a fraction of the axis. The drags covered the full 0-2048 raw range on both axes, so the touch area covers the whole screen.

report_interval_us.note: OBSERVED: about 113 Hz while a finger moves. A finger held still produces almost no events, because the kernel only passes on changed values.

reported_axes.note: OBSERVED in the capture: no pressure or contact size, positions only.

hold_jitter_note: Not measured. The 3 s centre hold produced only 12 position samples (std about 2.3 and 3.5 raw units), because a still finger sends almost no events. Treat jitter as unknown; a later test can measure it with deliberate tiny movements.
